q: Last night my husband basically said my mindset about it is weak/ soft and my son is going to grow up to be disrespectful if I let him “walk all over me”. I couldn’t even come up with a rebuttal, bc again, I’m so fucking tired.
cx: Mother of a three-year-old and a 10-month-old, burnt out by daily power struggles.

q: I feel like I’ve tried every trick in the book to make things easier. I am just so tired of repeating myself day after day for the same things! I’m exhausted, burnt out, and I’m at the point where I don’t even want to try anymore. Don’t want to brush your teeth? Fine.
Am I just too strict of a parent? What is wrong with me? Why is everything a battle? I miss my sweet little boy and I’m ready for this stage to be over.

When I’m not with him everyone tells me he’s sooo good and sweet. And I know I get the brunt of his “bad” behavior bc he is safe with me and is able to express his big emotions without ill consequences. It just sucks though man I want the good parts too.

My daughter comes to work with me while my son goes to daycare so I don’t get much me/alone time although my husband tries to allot those for me. The few hours a month doesn’t seem like much of a break bc I know when I’m back home I’m just back in the shit of it all.
I feel like I wasn’t warned enough about this stage. People talk about the terrible 2s but he was sweet as pie! And when year 3 approached he just flipped a switch and is just a tiny terrorist.
I am definitely inconsistent when it comes to the follow through part of the command. Sometimes it’s bc I’m also trying to get my 10 month old ready at the same time.
The emotional regulation is by far the hardest for me and my husband I constantly have to remind him and myself that he cannot emotionally regulate if WE can’t even do it.
Reading all the comments and kind of going through how we handle things makes me see that we are in fact doing the best we can as a united front.
she knew the word “no” existed before. she used it all the time. but never AT me. now it’s only ever AT me. any request, demand, inquiry… it doesn’t matter. it’s a ‘tude filled NO. and i’m losing it.
cx: First-time mother; daughter nearly 2.5 changed overnight.

q:
her: i want a sucker.   
me: no, it’s 7:32 in the morning.   
her: yes.

(literally as i’m typing this, i had to get up and stop her from hitting the back door. i said “stop, we do not hit”. she removed her hand for half a second, looked back up at me really fast and put her hand back on it.
i feel like such a bad mom lately. i have no idea what to do. i thought i figured her out and i lost it all. nothing works.
is there a magic wand at the overstimulated and newly sleep exhausted since the newborn stage mom store?
i’ve heard about the “how to talk so little kids will listen” book so many times, even before i had my own. i think it’s time to bite the bullet and make the purchase.
what worked before with redirection and such is no longer working and i need to adjust to the changes by changing my approach.
i’m often the only person available to give myself reassurance and it doesn’t work as well when it comes from your own mind sometimes.
I work 6-2am every night, I have a newborn I’m still waking with and nap time is my only decompress time. How do I fix this.
cx: Nearly three-year-old fights naps since a 10-week-old sister and the dummy going.

q: Today I snuggled her for 10 minutes and said mommy has to go now. She flings herself at me wants to be held, wants to snuggle, cries, tries to prevent me from leaving her room.
